column2: ArgumentParser and filesystem entry point; ConventionalCommitCLITests covers command parsing, diagnostics and file reads.
Filesystem diagnostic adapter exercised by ConventionalCommitCLITests unreadable-file integration.

ArgumentParser entry points; ContractGenerationTests.cliGeneratesChecksAndReportsDrift covers generation, check, unchanged files and nonzero drift diagnostics. Schema reading, projection, emission and ownership remain measured.
ArgumentParser and filesystem entry points; CoverageCLITests and CoverageGateTests exercise command parsing, reports and scope output.
ArgumentParser and streaming filesystem adapter; DiagnosticsCLITests cover ordered segments, partial and long lines, empty directories, root resolution and failures. Aggregation remains measured.
ArgumentParser executable entry point exercised through tooling CLI integration tests.
ArgumentParser and filesystem entry point; RepositoryCheckCLITests exercises the same MagicKeyScanner through the repository check gate.

ArgumentParser and live clock/UUID/sleep composition; MonitoringCLITests exercise command registration, help and invalid arguments without contacting the lab. Readiness, OTLP payloads and query evidence remain measured.
ArgumentParser and appcast filesystem entry point; ReleaseCLITests covers XML output, root resolution, history, notes, invalid arguments and I/O errors.
ArgumentParser and guarded version-file entry point; ReleaseCLITests and ReleaseVersionIntegrationTests cover validation, forwarding and unchanged files on errors.
ArgumentParser release registration exercised by ReleaseCLITests and release shell integration fixtures.
ArgumentParser and release filesystem entry point; ReleaseCLITests and HomebrewReleaseTests cover preflight, published metadata, immutable artifacts and retry.
ArgumentParser repository check entry point exercised by RepositoryCheckCLITests.
ArgumentParser subcommand registration exercised through repository CLI integration tests.
ArgumentParser and filesystem entry point; UserVisibleStringScannerTests exercise the scanner itself, and RepositoryCheckCLITests covers the shared repository scan shape.
Invocation-directory and explicit-root filesystem adapter exercised by ConventionalCommitCLITests and CoverageCLITests.
FileManager traversal and metadata adapter; CoverageScopeTests cover files, directories, symlinks, roots and I/O failures. Pure manifest, path and partition rules remain measured.

Ephemeral URLSession and redirect delegate adapter; MonitoringHTTPClientTests exercise real isolated loopback receivers, full request/response values, GET/POST redirect refusal, HTTP errors, timeout and cancellation. No lab endpoint is contacted.
Streaming FileHandle and CryptoKit adapter; ReleaseArtifactFileSystemTests and ReleaseCLITests cover multiple chunks, known SHA-256 vectors, empty files, filename validation and read failures.

FileManager repository scan adapter; RepositoryPolicyFileSystemTests and RepositoryCheckCLITests cover real files, skipped build trees and check failures. All deterministic repository policies remain measured.
POSIX exclusive-create and rename adapter; AtomicFileWriterTests cover mode preservation, no-op inode and mtime, concurrent edits, new outputs, symlink refusal and staged-file cleanup.
Protocol, response struct and output typealiases with no executable lines; MonitoringHTTPClientTests exercise the URLSession adapter and all deterministic clients.
